title: tunnel_auth revocation_root_change test expects Replay but gets Revoked
description: Test revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed in rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:922 fails with assertion error at line 954. After revoking a claim and then trying to re-accept the same claim, the test expects TunnelAuthError::Replay but receives TunnelAuthError::Revoked. This suggests the revocation state is being checked before the replay state, which may be a logic ordering issue. The test expects that replay detection should take precedence over revocation detection for claims with the same path_seq.
